{{Quote|There were four organizations which gathered and analyzed intelligence for the Senate and other agencies of the Old Republic - the Republican Security Organization, the Senate Bureau of Intelligence, the Interstellar Consortium on Technology, and the euphemistically labeled Special Acquisitions Branch of the Library of the Republic.|A report from the Imperial Security Bureau to the ISB Central Office, prepared shortly after the Battle of Yavin|<ref name="ISB" />}}
The '''Interstellar Consortium on Technology''' was a service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during its later years. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was assimilated into [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]<ref name="ISB" /> under the direction of<ref name="iad">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> former [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|SBI]] [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]].<ref name="HNN #50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_3.html|Isard Spearheads Republic Intelligence Reform}}</ref>
